newsitem.title: USA: KEPCO expected to issue $200 mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: KEPCO expected to issue $200 mln in debt.

text.p: Korea Electric Power Corp (KEPCO) is expected to tap the corporate bond market with a $200 million debt offering via underwriter Lehman Brothers, dealers said on Tuesday.
The deal is expected to consist of a 30-year maturity with a putable option in the seventh year, dealers said.
On July 18, KEPCO filed a shelf registration with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for up to $600 million in debt securities.
Proceeds from the sale will be used for general coarporate purposes including capital expenditures, debt-refinancing and overseas investments.
(( -- Nancy Leinfuss, U.S. corporate bond unit,
